resources.string: Tasks stay on this device. Sign-in does not join a household. Sync is not available yet.
The installation identity was missing or did not match. Unexpected files are quarantined. Sign in for a new device registration. Encrypted files cannot be opened without their original device key.
The operation failed. Source data is unchanged. Try again.
Exports contain private text. Choose the destination carefully. Export recordings separately from the voice menu.
Text exported. Original data is unchanged.
Selected text is copied into new local tasks. Originals stay unchanged. Moving it into a household will require a separate selection.
Delete this account\'s local data and sign out
This registration expired or was revoked. Register again to unlock this account. Local text stays available for recovery and is not replayed to a household.

Cancel and export first if you need a backup. Sign-out locks retained data to the same account. If you chose deletion, local data is permanently deleted. Revoking a registration blocks that device\'s future mutations.
Device registration failed. If the device limit was reached, choose an old registration to revoke.
